selected.where: even_index_ints = [i for i in new_list if new_list.index(i) % 2 == 0]
selected.how: index(i) returns the first occurrence of value i, not the current loop index, causing duplicate values to be misclassified by parity.
selected.what: Input [2, 1, 2] yields [2, 1, 2] instead of [2, 1, 2] (if sorted) or incorrect sorting due to wrong index parity detection.
